prompt:
Image 1 is the hero of this game: a Q-style super-deformed chibi medieval hedge-wizard, about two and a half heads tall with an enormous head and huge round eyes, in a deep heraldic blue hooded wool cloak with cream linen lining, a brown leather belt, brown boots, holding a rough wooden staff topped by a glowing amber crystal. Use this exact character design and these exact chibi proportions.

TASK: Draw a wide, bright, celebratory SPLASH SCREEN / title key art for this game, set in a MEDIEVAL world.

COMPOSITION: the chibi hedge-wizard stands front and centre, drawn LARGE, in a heroic casting pose: the wooden staff raised high overhead with the amber crystal blazing, the other little fist clenched, feet planted wide apart, a huge determined grin on the face. Around and behind the mage, a few much SMALLER cartoon enemies react to the spell - a round violet marsh flame recoiling on one side and a little crimson-cowled revenant on the other, with a chunky little knight in steel plate further back. Big cartoon spell effects: a warm amber and gold magic circle on the ground under the mage, radiating energy rings, and a shower of warm sparks and star glints filling the air.

IMPORTANT - LEAVE ROOM FOR A TITLE: keep the TOP THIRD of the image relatively open and uncluttered, filled with sky and sparks rather than characters or busy detail, so a game logo can be placed there later. Keep the mage's head below that top area.

BACKGROUND: a bright cheerful medieval castle courtyard - crenellated stone walls, a gatehouse with an open portcullis, tall heraldic banners on poles, a warm afternoon sky with soft clouds, distant hills. Upbeat and inviting.

ART DIRECTION: Q-style chibi storybook. VERY THICK bold dark ink outlines on every character, flat 2-tone cel shading, hand-painted medieval warmth - heraldic blue, cream linen, brass and ochre, warm brown leather, muted stone grey - high key and vibrant but earthy, like an illuminated manuscript brought to life. One key light from the upper-left.

TECHNICAL OUTPUT: 3:2 landscape, edge-to-edge artwork, opaque, no transparency.

EXCLUDE: modern objects, plastic, neon, glowing cyan, sci-fi, robots, any text, letters, words, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, UI elements, buttons, borders, frames, a dark or moody palette, realistic or tall proportions, gore.
